title: Signature Tool: Circuit Sketchpad
description: Manon's Circuit Sketchpad concept: a visual circuit editor where gates are dragged onto wires and the state vector updates live beside the circuit — every gate shows its immediate effect on probabilities. The tool's signature feature is 'why' mode: click any amplitude and it traces which gates created it. Designed for learning, it caps at 4 qubits so the math stays visible. Signature concept.

title: Signature Tool: Noise Painter

title: Signature Tool: Error Budget Planner

'Every quantum program has an error budget; most just never write it down.' Signature concept.

title: Signature Tool: Readout Fixer
description: Manon's Readout Fixer concept: a one-click readout-error correction tool — it measures the device's confusion matrix once, then inverts it on every result histogram automatically. The tool shows the raw vs corrected distributions side by side so the user sees exactly what the correction bought. Readout error is the cheapest error to fix, and this tool makes it free. Signature concept.
